name: shloka-learn-android
description: Mobile app wrapper (Capacitor for Android & iOS) for Shloka Learn

scripts.sync: npm run www && npx cap sync
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.aab: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew clean bundleRelease
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
